items.title: As Meta's Muse arrives in the UK, FCA issues agentic AI warning to tech firms
items.why: Regulators are signaling that AI agents handling money will face oversight, which will shape any future assistant-based card partnerships.
items.summary_ai: Meta's Muse AI agent reached the UK as the FCA warned tech and social platforms that money-related AI agents could draw scrutiny.
items.take: Regulators are signaling that AI agents handling money will face oversight, which will shape any future assistant-based card partnerships.

items.title: Walmart Turns to Meta’s Muse to Power Black Friday
items.why: Agentic shopping is moving checkout into AI assistants, a channel card issuers will need to reach with offers.
items.summary_ai: Walmart is letting shoppers use Meta's Muse agent to find Black Friday deals and buy through its Agent Gateway.
